hero.h1: React Native at scale, with AI inside.
hero.lede: I’m Yauheni Horbach — a Senior React Native developer with 5 years shipping cross-platform apps for European banks and e-commerce, plus 100+ merged PRs into Expensify. Lately: integrating LLM features into mobile products, end-to-end.

about.heading: A short manifesto.
about.p1: I build cross-platform mobile apps that ship. iOS, Android and Web from a single React Native codebase, with the kind of performance and animation work that separates a port from a real native experience.
about.p2: Five years at EPAM growing from Junior to Senior, owning critical features for major European banks and e-commerce. Two years contributing to New Expensify — one of the largest open-source RN / RN Web codebases — promoted to Contributor+ after 100+ merged PRs.
about.p3: Lately: LLM features inside mobile products. Streaming, tool use, structured output, prompt caching and RAG — wired into Expo apps with Supabase (Postgres + RLS) behind them.

epam.what: Progressed Junior → Middle → Senior React Native developer; key dev on teams from a few people up to 10. Delivered production mobile apps for major European banks and e-commerce. Led the CI migration from Jenkins to GitHub Actions, introduced integration and E2E test coverage, and owned architecture and library decisions end-to-end.

expensify.what: Long-running open-source contributions to one of the largest React Native / RN Web codebases. 100+ merged PRs across iOS, Android, Desktop and Web. Promoted to Contributor+ — reviewing external proposals before they reach an Expensify engineer, then acting as first reviewer on the resulting PRs across all four platforms.

ai.what: Building personal mobile products around Anthropic’s Claude API — contextual recommendations, route planning with time estimation, group decision flows. End-to-end ownership: Expo, Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Edge Functions), Mapbox.

rs.what: Mentor at The Rolling Scopes School across multiple cohorts — weekly sessions with groups of 2–6 students, code-level PR reviews and grading on the front-end track, plus training interviews preparing each student for real hiring loops.
